description: This file contains the class AndroidInlineUtil, which provides utility methods for inlining Android styles and layouts within an IDE plugin, including methods for retrieving style data, performing inlining actions, and managing references and conflicts.

classes.name: AndroidInlineUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for inlining Android styles and layouts within an IDE plugin.

classes.name: MyStyleData
classes.description: Data class holding style name, style element, and referred element for inlining operations.

methods.name: getInlinableStyleData
methods.description: Retrieves style data that can be inlined from an XML tag.

methods.name: getStyleUsageData
methods.description: Gets usage data for a style from an XML tag.

methods.name: getLayoutUsageData
methods.description: Gets layout usage data from an XML tag.

methods.name: doInlineStyleDeclaration
methods.description: Performs the inlining of a style declaration, either for a single usage or all usages.

methods.name: getInlinableStyleDataFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves inlinable style data from a given PSI element context.

methods.name: addReferences
methods.description: Adds references of a PSI element to a collection of usage info.

methods.name: buildConflicts
methods.description: Builds a map of conflict messages for different usage categories.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a PSI element to a string representation for conflict messages.

methods.name: doInlineLayoutFile
methods.description: Performs inlining of an entire layout file.
